report_summary.data_feed: offline csv (feed unknown; downloader used the configured historical feed)
report_summary.data_feed_note: SIP consolidates the national market system tape.

drawdown_halt_shadow_events.note: Offline backtest: entries were NOT blocked at these points (the curve kept trading). Under the production drawdown policy each event is a halt until an operator starts a new risk epoch.

report_summary.fill_model: decision on closed bar; next tradable bar open
report_summary.price_adjustment_model: split-adjusted execution/signal prices with explicit dividend cash flows; callers must not supply split actions for already split-adjusted bars

regulatory_fee_model.note: SEC Section 31, FINRA TAF and CAT fees are approximated per trade date from the official rate schedules when equity_use_effective_dated_fees is enabled; otherwise the configured fixed current regulatory rates are used. Either way this is a fixed-rate approximation, not exact historical fees — verify the rates in force at the trade date before using results as a cost proxy.

report_summary.survivorship_bias_limitation: Candidate metadata may reflect currently supported Alpaca assets; historical scanner membership is point-in-time within the supplied bar set, but delisted assets cannot be reconstructed when the provider omits them.
report_summary.universe_methodology: daily production scanner policy on trailing 60d metrics; inputs strictly precede snapshot; Stage-A shortlist capped at 300 symbols by trailing median dollar volume; historical spread and broad sector/tradability metadata unavailable and explicitly degraded
